objective: Train the learned mechanisms on the P2 error of Algorithm-2 aggregation, J_kappa = kappa*||alpha-pi||^2 + |I|/S^2, and give them the public task parameter kappa as an extra input; everything else as in the task-aware execution layer.

unchanged: Dirichlet client split and Opacus-safe sizes
contracts.settlement (minimum event epsilon 0.01, reject over-capacity, reject negative true utility)
DP-SGD runner and exact per-event calibration
Algorithm 2 epsilon-proportional aggregation (--aggr eps) for every arm except the declared diagnostic
CNN, initialisation, optimizer, learning rates (MNIST 0.1, CIFAR-10 0.05), batch 64, one local epoch
evaluation: mean accuracy of the final five rounds
development evaluation set: the CNN-development half of the reserved 10% training records, as in the task-aware campaign; never the official test set before Stage 3

stage_minus1_kappa_hat.warmup: 5 rounds of non-private FedAvg with data-size weights through the runner's own local-training path with an explicit noise multiplier of 1e-6 (same sampling, clipping 1.0, optimizer, averaging); initial model as in the runner for that seed
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.measurement: round 6: clean clipped local updates of all 10 clients from the warm global model (float parameters only, flattened)
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.zeta2: p2_reference.kappa_from_updates (unbiased dispersion around the unweighted mean)
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.noise_energy: per client: runner.preview_participation(allocated_event_epsilon=1.0) gives noise multiplier, sample rate and optimizer steps; p2_reference.dp_noise_energy with clip 1.0, the dataset learning rate and the number of float parameters
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.kappa_hat: geometric mean over the two seeds of zeta2 / mean noise energy, per (dataset, alpha)
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.also_report: the same quantities measured at the initial model (round 1); reference only, not used
stage_minus1_kappa_hat.freeze: write kappa_hat.json and record its SHA256 in the Stage 0 manifest before any Stage 0 FL run

stage0_oracle_check.purpose: Does aligning purchased privacy with data shares raise CNN accuracy under unchanged Algorithm 2? No mechanism training.
stage0_oracle_check.shares: pi from the reported (verified) sizes reports[...,2] of each round

arms.Oracle-k0: p2_reference.p2_oracle(kappa=0): largest affordable total under cost-only payments, i.e. every cap when affordable; stands for the saturating mechanisms
arms.Aligned@PAC: p2_reference.aligned_at_total with the per-round executed total of PAC in the same round and budget
arms.Aligned@CSRA: p2_reference.aligned_at_total with the per-round executed total of CSRA
arms.Oracle-k0-datasize: allocation of Oracle-k0 with --aggr datasize; diagnostic only, never a candidate

stage0_oracle_check.payments: oracle and aligned arms pay cost v_i*eps_i (non-strategic upper references); settled through contracts.settlement
stage0_oracle_check.kappa_rule_selection: per dataset choose the rule among {0.01 (evaluated by Oracle-k0), kappa_hat(dataset, alpha), 3, 30} with the highest mean development accuracy over both alphas and both seeds; ties go to the earlier rule in this list

gate.pass_if: CIFAR10: mean development accuracy of the best of {Oracle-khat, Oracle-k3, Oracle-k30} exceeds the best of {CSRA, PAC, Oracle-k0} by at least 1.0 percentage point (means over both alphas and both seeds)
report_without_gating: realised TV, purchased epsilon, participants, J_kappa
gate.on_fail: stop the P2 route; write the decision and results; release the task-aware confirmation hold
gate.training_kappa_range: log-uniform [0.003, 300]; if a selected kappa lies outside [0.03, 30], use [min(0.003, k/10), max(300, 10k)] over the selected values; record before Stage 1

optional_candidate.mfg_p2_share: mfg_p2 plus per-client d_i/mean(d) and cap_i/mean(cap) columns derived from the reports and the mean-field row

stage1_training.kappa_input: p2_reference.kappa_feature over the training range, appended to the network input like the budget feature
stage1_training.objective: replace the procurement term by mean p2_reference.p2_training_term(executed_eps, truthful_reports, kappa); keep the IR and regret augmented-Lagrangian terms and the budget projection
stage1_training.warm_start: supervised imitation of p2_reference.p2_oracle allocations on a precomputed bank of training-distribution profiles (sample_profiles budgets, kappa log-uniform over the training range), payment targets max(v_i, posted price at B) * eps_i scaled to the budget; identical for all families
stage1_training.schedule: task-aware schedule: 6000 warm steps, 6000 constrained steps, the last 2000 with the strong evaluation search at learning rate 3e-5; batch 64; identical for all families
stage1_training.search_domain: valuation [0,1], cap [0, true cap], and downward size reports in [10, d_i] (grid d_i, 0.75 d_i, 0.5 d_i, 0.25 d_i, 10, then PGA on all three coordinates)
stage1_training.public_pilot: before Stage 2, economic-only CPU pilots may fix learning rate, dual step and normalisation; decisions use only economic metrics, apply to all families and are archived

screen.kappa_values: the selected deployment kappa values of both datasets
screen.regret: normalised mean found regret (gain / (B/N)) under the extended search must not exceed, at every budget, the larger of RegretNet-r2 and No-population-r2 evaluated with the same search; the strict 0.02 decision is reported separately
screen.p2: J_kappa of the executed allocation must be below that of V8F at B=30 and B=100 for each deployment kappa
screen.monotonicity: violation rates for v increased by 0.1, cap decreased by 10%, size decreased by 10% (change in own executed eps beyond 1e-3 in the wrong direction) must not exceed the larger of the two references
report: regret without the size dimension, for comparison with round 2

arms: Oracle-P2 (selected kappa; for privacy cells the aligned allocation at total 10*target)
stage2_development.privacy_cells: budgets calibrated per arm on CPU from allocations only, 100-round mean executed epsilon within 0.5% of the target, range [0.5, 110]; unreachable (arm, cell) pairs are not run and are listed with the reason; job lists carry exact budgets and expected allocation SHA256
stage2_development.selection: one checkpoint per family by mean development accuracy over all cells it can enter; ties by mean development cross-entropy
stage2_development.gate: selected MFG-P2 minus the best available of {CSRA, PAC, V8F} per cell, averaged over the CIFAR10 cells, is at least 0.5 percentage point; and selected MFG-P2 minus V8F averaged over the MNIST cells is at least -0.3 percentage point
stage2_development.on_fail: stop; write results; release the task-aware confirmation hold

stage3_confirmation.cells: budget: MNIST B in {10, 30, 100}, CIFAR10 B in {30, 100}; privacy: target in {0.5, 0.8} for both datasets; all with alpha in {0.5, 0.1}; 18 cells
stage3_confirmation.endpoint: mean accuracy of rounds 96-100; also macro-F1, cross-entropy, payments, purchased epsilon, TV, participants, J_kappa, cumulative RDP
stage3_confirmation.analysis: seed-paired differences of MFG-RegretNet-P2 against every arm with 95% intervals; all cells, arms and seeds reported

cross_campaign_rule.hold: no task-aware confirmation job starts until this rule decides
cross_campaign_rule.rule: if P2 passes its Stage 2 gate, P2 goes to Stage 3 and the task-aware campaign stays at development (reported in the supplement); if P2 stops at Stage 0 or Stage 2, the hold is released and the task-aware protocol applies unchanged

reporting: all stages, arms, cells, seeds and failures are reported
no selection on official test accuracy
no protocol change after the first Stage 0 FL run without a dated amendment file stating what changed and why, written before the affected runs
